text:
emma.sre: :rotating_light: Observability alert - canary rollout 2024.11.5 -> throttle policy misapplied, latency and 5xx spike. Paging oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2024.11.5-5472 started at 2045002420, initial traffic 5% -> 20% -> 100% (automatic ramp).

emma.sre: The automated rollback did not trigger. health checks returned 200 but response body is the maintenance banner (so healthcheck is false-positive).

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-24011 - Canary health mismatch -> user-facing latency increase. Severity: P2, notify oncall.

raj.platform: I'm oncall. Paging in. What metrics?

emma.sre: 95th latency for text-gen endpoints jumped from 120ms -> 5.3s. 5xx rate across canary hosts ~18% over last 3min. Token consumption per-request doubled. See query log snippet below:

```
[2045002435] host-canary-3 infer: kv_cache_miss=0.68 token_rate=2.1x OOM-soft=1 cpu=87% latency=5200ms 5xx=0.17
[2045002440] host-canary-4 infer: kv_cache_miss=0.71 token_rate=1.95x cpu=91% latency=4800ms 5xx=0.19
```

marta-support: Customer ticket volume is up. A few enterprise customers reported timeouts on embed endpoints. They flagged two paid tenants with heavy throughput.

derek-eng: Confirming: the rollout feature flag for the new batching+throttle logic was supposed to be gated to pilot users only, but the flag-level audience was mis-specified and hit all traffic during ramp.

lee-prodops: Can we flip the flag back immediately? Which flag key?

emma.sre: Flag key: `rollout/batching-throttle/v2`. Rollback plan: 1) flip flag to off, 2) manual deploy rollback if flip doesn't recover, 3) drain canary hosts, 4) verify smoke and metrics.

raj.platform: Flipping flag now in LaunchDarkly... :hourglass:

emma.sre: While that's happening, I'll prepare manual rollback command and drain steps. If flag flip returns 200->error in healthcheck we still want rollback.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift detected: 100% -> 100% (no automatic unwinds). Auto-rollback policy: health-check-body-match required but not configured.

derek-eng: Ugh. We missed the body-match. I'll update the rollback policy after we stabilize. For now: manual rollback steps below.

```
# rollback to previous stable
deploy rollback --env=prod --service=inference --to=2024.11.4-9811 --reason="canary throttling regression"

# drain canary instances (prod tag: canary-5472)
kubectl -n inference label node <node> maintenance=draining
kubectl -n inference rollout pause deploy/inference-canary
kubectl -n inference delete pod -l deployment=inference-canary --grace-period=60
```

lee-prodops: Flag flip returned :white_check_mark: - `rollout/batching-throttle/v2` now off. Latencies starting to trend down on initial probes (95p -> 1.2s). Still seeing some 5xx from queued requests.

emma.sre: Good. Continue with draining. Raj, can you initiate the deploy rollback if 95p doesn't fall below 500ms in 3 min?

raj.platform: On it. If no improvement by 2045002650 I'll run rollback.

marta-support: I'll update customer tickets with status and ETA. Notifying affected enterprise CSMs now.

incident-bot: Paging webhook sent to mobile oncall.

emma.sre: Manual drain command (run on prod ops host):

```
curl -s -X POST "https://ops-api.internal/drain" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"tag":"canary-5472","grace_seconds":60}'
```

lee-prodops: Drain started. Observability: concurrent requests on canary pool dropping. 5xx dropping from 18% -> 6% in last 90s.

derek-eng: If rollback is needed, note that the model binary has a new quantization profile; rolling back requires forcing previous model bundle and clearing prefix cache to avoid stale KV mismatches. Also note cache purge command below.

```
# purge prefix cache for model v2
redis-cli -h kvcache.redis cluster -c "KEYS pf:v2:*" | xargs -r redis-cli -h kvcache.redis DEL
```

emma.sre: We should coordinate with infra so we don't evict healthy state for other services. Use `--match pf:v2:*` only. Derek, handle that.

raj.platform: 95p is at 420ms now, 5xx ~2.7%. No rollback executed. I'm holding.

marta-support: Customers acknowledged ETA. Some asked for a formal postmortem timeline. I'll coordinate with ops for post-incident notes.

emma.sre: Actions assigned:
- raj.platform: hold / rollback if metrics regress (assigned)
- lee-prodops: complete drain + confirm canary pods terminated (assigned)
- derek-eng: run prefix cache purge if we rollback or see KV errors (assigned)
- marta-support: customer comms (assigned)

incident-bot: Incident status changed: monitoring. Severity remains P2.

lee-prodops: Drain finished. All canary pods terminated, new traffic shifted back to stable.

raj.platform: final check: 95p 180ms, 5xx 0.6%. Closing active mitigation.

emma.sre: Great run. Postmortem owners: derek-eng + raj.platform. Please include root cause (flag audience misconfig), checklist changes (healthcheck-body-match), and rollback policy update.

marta-support: I'll draft customer-facing summary and PTL notes.

incident-bot: Incident INC-24011 marked resolved at 2045002798.

emma.sre: :white_check_mark: Closing thread. Thanks everyone for fast response.
